standard.summary: 开着时丢掉音轨，只让视频分支参与训练；ref2va（单帧参考生视频+音频）任务例外，仍然带音频。
standard.effect: audio latents 在 train step 里直接不加载，音频侧 loss 与 CFG 合成整段不执行。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集音频质量差、或只想练视频分支时。
standard.avoidWhen: 要练音视频联合生成时——这会静默去掉一半监督信号。ref2va 任务不受此开关影响，别指望用它关掉参考任务的音频。

standard_en.summary: When on, the audio track is dropped and only the video branch trains; the ref2va task (one reference frame to video plus audio) is exempt and still carries audio.
standard_en.effect: Audio latents are not loaded in the train step at all, so the audio loss and audio CFG composition never run.
standard_en.whenToUse: When dataset audio quality is poor, or you only want to train the video branch.
standard_en.avoidWhen: For joint audio-video generation -- this silently removes half the supervision. ref2va tasks ignore this switch, so do not expect it to mute a reference task's audio.

advanced.principle: train_step 用 cached.one_frame_task == 'ref2va' or not h3_video_only 决定是否保留 audio latents；保留后再按 audio_present 掩码剔除缺失音频的样本，混批（部分有音频）直接报错要求重新分桶或把 batch 降到 1。
advanced.intervention: DiT 前向之前的输入准备，模型与 loss 结构不变。
advanced.expectedImpact: 开启后每步少一次音频分支前向，显存与耗时都下降。
advanced.tradeoffs: 缓存在数据集层面已经建好，开关只影响读取；要彻底省下音频缓存的磁盘占用得重建缓存。

advanced_en.principle: train_step keeps audio latents based on cached.one_frame_task == 'ref2va' or not h3_video_only; after that it masks out samples without audio by audio_present, and a mixed batch (some with audio) raises immediately, asking for re-bucketing or batch size 1.
advanced_en.intervention: Input preparation before the DiT forward; the model and loss structure are unchanged.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Turning it on removes one audio-branch forward per step, cutting both VRAM and time.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Caches are already built at the dataset layer, so the switch only affects reading; reclaiming the audio cache's disk footprint needs a rebuild.
